cards.text: Just before this, the LORD sent Jeremiah, His prophet, down to a potter's house to hear His message (Jeremiah 18:2). Now the LORD has a new errand for him: go buy a clay jar from a potter. As a stamper who got picked up for a quarter when a bakery closed its doors, I LOVE a story that starts with shopping.

cards.question: Jeremiah isn't making this trip with his clay jar alone. Who does the LORD tell him to take along?

answers.text: Some elders and leaders of the priests
The gatekeepers and the temple singers
The king and his royal officials

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Jeremiah to go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim His words there. A prophet, some elders, some priests and a clay jar walk into a valley, and friend, this is NOT the start of a joke.

cards.question: The message the LORD gives Jeremiah to proclaim in the valley is for the kings of ___ and the residents of Jerusalem.

answers.text: Judah
Moab
Egypt

cards.text: The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says He's going to bring such disaster on this place that the ears of all who hear of it will ring.

cards.question: Why does the LORD say He's bringing this disaster on the people of Judah and Jerusalem?

answers.text: They abandoned Him for other gods
They lost a battle to Egypt
They broke a treaty with Babylon

cards.question: The LORD says the gods the people burned incense to were gods their fathers and the kings of Judah had known for generations.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: The LORD says they've made this a foreign place and filled it with the blood of the innocent. They built high places to Baal, a false god, to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal.

cards.question: The LORD says burning children as offerings to Baal is something He never commanded, and it never even entered His mind.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: So the days are coming, the LORD says, when this place won't be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom anymore. It'll be called the Valley of Slaughter.
In this place, the LORD says, He'll ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. They'll fall by the sword before their enemies, by the hands of those who seek their lives.

cards.question: The LORD says the bodies of those who fall in Judah and Jerusalem will be food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: The LORD says He'll make Jerusalem a desolation. How will the people passing by the city react?

answers.text: Be appalled and scoff at her wounds
Stop and help bind up her wounds
Mourn for her and bring her gifts

cards.text: Friend, this part is as heavy as it gets. In the siege and distress their enemies bring on them, the LORD says He'll make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they'll eat one another's flesh.
Remember that clay jar from the potter? Right in front of the men who came along, the LORD tells Jeremiah to shatter it.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll shatter this nation and this city like someone shatters a potter's jar. What does He say about that jar?

answers.text: It can never again be repaired
Its pieces will be kept as a sign
A better jar will replace it

cards.question: The LORD says they will bury the dead in ___ until there is no more room to bury them.

answers.text: Topheth
Shiloh
Bethel

cards.text: The LORD says He'll make this city like Topheth. The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like that place.

cards.question: On the rooftops of those houses in Jerusalem, people burned incense to all the host of heaven. What else did they do up there?

answers.text: Poured out drink offerings to other gods
Kept watch for the enemy's armies
Prayed toward the house of the LORD

cards.text: Then Jeremiah returns from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy. And he carries the message somewhere a whole lot of people can hear it.

cards.question: After coming back from Topheth, where does Jeremiah stand to proclaim the LORD's message?

answers.text: The courtyard of the house of the LORD
The Benjamin Gate of Jerusalem
The palace of the king of Judah

cards.text: And this time it isn't just the elders and the priests who hear it. He proclaims it to ALL the people, like when the memo from the small meeting goes out to the whole company.

The LORD of Hosts says He's about to bring every disaster He has pronounced, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to heed His words. Not the stiff neck you get from falling asleep on the couch, friend, but the kind where you hear every word and STILL won't turn your head.

cards.question: The LORD says the disaster He pronounced will come on Jerusalem and on all the villages around it.

answers.text: True
False
